notes: All data is synthetic. Indexed parent/child pages are selected before provider filtering, bounded to1000keys.
Each measured child-page plan stages1000wrong-provider rows in the isolated fixture, reenables triggers, performs the real repair and rolls back. Measured updates are real, not zero-row lookups.
The before_manual_analyze label records observed statistics, not a guaranteed stale-statistics experiment.

Current migration timings and the successful worst-case10M repair are under fresh_current_chain_benchmark. historical_migration_ledger combines previous executions and is retained only as historical provenance.

The earlier interrupted validation and resume evidence is retained separately. The fresh_current_chain_benchmark passes from legacy schema through all current migrations,10M repaired rows and both validated FKs.
evidence_scope: Synthetic owned PostgreSQL14, 10M reconciliation rows, 1M streams, 100003 links. No production access or latency guarantee.
